date_note: dpa (via Volksstimme, updated 19 November) says the attack happened overnight into Wednesday, resolved to 18 November.
exec: A German municipal utility's telephone and internet services were disrupted by what the utility called a targeted attack, per dpa.
geo_basis: utility's home town named in the source
plain: A targeted attack hit the Wittenberg municipal utility in Germany, disrupting phone and internet service for customers of its subsidiary. Services were largely restored by 19 November.
summary: dpa, via Volksstimme, reports that Stadtwerke Wittenberg identified a targeted attack as the cause of a telephone and internet disruption that began overnight into Wednesday. The report says customers of the subsidiary Wittenberg-Net were affected and that the utility disconnected and shut down all relevant systems as a precaution. Telephone and internet were largely restored by 19 November.
title: Stadtwerke Wittenberg says a targeted attack disrupted phone and internet for customers of its subsidiary

validation.note: One dpa report (Volksstimme); Security-Insider's page carries the same dpa text. Relays the utility's own statement; single publisher.
